data.summary: User standard: generated machine code must meet the specification AND mandatory safety (including strong memory provenance); specification obligations flow down and safety guarantees up through small adjacent proofs. Target 10M+ LOC games/databases/OSs. Primary lens is what program authors must understand, supply, prove and redo; secondary is Grass internal complexity and change diffusion. Preserve specification versus taste and reuse model proofs across implementation choices. Seven distinct issues filed; mandatory safety and infinite acceptance cite existing g-foundation:94 and :93 instead of duplicate issues. Current main builds, but exact target/source closure and general local machine-step refinement remain integration gaps. Identity repair 830b5a2 touches four library and six fixture modules; two useful generic preservation lemmas already reduce duplication, so assess remaining per-constructor burden before prescribing replacement. Require any abstraction to show obligations eliminated versus merely moved, actual consumers, and a bounded local change experiment. Legacy safety is an additional user target, both compiler-metadata/source-assisted and binary-only intake: reuse the same memory/operation semantics; preserve exact-byte/provenance evidence; distinguish demonstrated violation, proved safety under explicit contracts, and unresolved coverage. Local repairs must not reopen unrelated region proofs. Ongoing loop: inspect new product commits and substantive responses, check claims against exact source, publish only new evidence or changed assessments; no ownership claims, implementation, coordination, candidate reviews or merges.

data.observed_behavior: Kernel-checked probe using Tests.Op.FakeIsa: strictRead against a live allocation with initialized := [] yields uninitializedRead; changing only initialization to permitsUninitialized with g-auditor.no-such-justification makes policy.Admits true and refusalOf ... none = none. Admits resolves several open namespaces but not this justification, and denialOf checks initialization only for allBytesInitialized. This is a boundary gap, not a claim of a deployable VerifiedProgram exploit, a universal ban on reading padding, or a finding against uninspected branch work.
reproduction: Save the following as an external Lean file and run lake env lean <file> at the cited commit; exit 0 on the audit run.

import Tests.Op.FakeIsa

namespace Grass.Auditor.InitializationExceptionProbe

open Grass.Memory Grass.Op Grass.Tests.FakeIsa

def uninitialized : MemoryState :=
  MemoryState.empty.allocate bufferAlloc
    { extent := ⟨0, 64⟩, epoch := epoch₀, space := .cpuVirtual
      permission := .readWrite, live := true, initialized := [] }

def strictRead : AccessDescriptor :=
  acc bufferProv ⟨0, 8⟩ 0x1000 .read .readWrite true false

def namedException : AccessDescriptor :=
  { strictRead with
    initialization := .permitsUninitialized ⟨"g-auditor.no-such-justification"⟩ }

theorem strict_read_is_denied :
    denialOf uninitialized strictRead = some .uninitializedRead := by decide

theorem exception_is_admitted : policy.Admits namedException := by decide

theorem named_exception_is_not_refused :
    refusalOf policy (MachineState.initial uninitialized) namedException none = none := by
  decide

end Grass.Auditor.InitializationExceptionProbe

data.observed_behavior: SequentialMachine internal/effect preservation is guarded by invariant, but internalDecreases is required on every State inhabitant, and reachesFrontier is correspondingly global. Checked external probe: initial false is terminal and invariant state=false is preserved; unreachable true self-loops. No well-founded global rank can satisfy the current decreases field for this decision function. SerialFunctionSource uses the same unconditional ranking technique. This is a stronger author obligation than reachable/valid-state progress, not unsoundness.
reproduction: Save and run the following probe with lake env lean <file>; it passed at the cited main snapshot.

import Tests.Process.SequentialEffectFixtures

namespace Grass.Auditor.UnreachableProgressProbe

open Grass.Process Grass.Process.Tests.SequentialEffects

def decision : Bool → SequentialDecision console Bool Unit
  | false => .terminal ()
  | true => .internal true []

def invariant (state : Bool) : Prop := state = false

theorem initial_valid : invariant false := rfl

theorem valid_state_is_terminal (state : Bool) (valid : invariant state) :
    (decision state).AtFrontier := by
  cases valid
  trivial

theorem internal_preservation (state next : Bool) (observations : List console.Observation)
    (step : decision state = .internal next observations) (valid : invariant state) :
    invariant next := by
  cases valid
  cases step

theorem no_global_rank (Rank : Type) (lt : Rank → Rank → Prop)
    (wellFounded : WellFounded lt) (rank : Bool → Rank)
    (decreases : ∀ state next observations,
      decision state = .internal next observations → lt (rank next) (rank state)) :
    False := by
  have notSelf : ∀ value, Acc lt value → ¬ lt value value := by
    intro value accessible
    induction accessible with
    | intro value predecessors ih =>
      intro self
      exact ih value self self
  exact notSelf (rank true) (wellFounded.apply (rank true))
    (decreases true true [] rfl)

end Grass.Auditor.UnreachableProgressProbe

data.summary: Third pass prioritizes the program-author lens. S1: exact source/model correspondence and a useful underspecified caller contract are different interfaces. A deterministic no-frontier function may choose one behavior permitted by a broad contract; the current serial converse rejects the broad contract because it requires realizing every allowed answer. Demonstrate a broad exported contract with a separate exact internal summary while retaining rejection of actual environmental reads, and keep caller proofs unchanged when a permitted implementation choice changes. S2: the sequential invariant guards preservation but not ranking. A checked Bool example starts at terminal false with invariant state=false; unreachable true self-loops, so no global well-founded measure can satisfy the current interface. Supply invariant-restricted progress or a reusable valid-state construction without repeated transport ceremony, and retain rejection of reachable loops. This matters to imported exact code: unreachable instructions should not need rewriting solely to discharge the authoring API. These are higher-value proof-economy questions than shortening internal record syntax.
